content: $i$ denotes the $i$th training sample, $y$ is the binary representation of true harassment label, and $y^{^{\prime }}$ is the predicted probability. In the loss function we have applied equal weight to both tasks. However, in the second task (type of harassment classification) we have applied higher weight in the categories that it is harder to predict due to the problem of the class imbalance between the training, validation and test sets respectively.
